raw_segments.text: Give orders for the marketplace to be swept tomorrow, and perhaps you'll find it," said
"'Enough, gentlemen, enough,' he decided in an exhausted voice.
I ought not to have been so ready.
Why, why did I degrade myself by confessing my secret to you?
I see that from your eyes.
You led me onto it, prosecutor.
Sing a hymn of triumph if you can.
